Commentary.Commentary: Only Shikha Pandey went for runs today. The others were excellent while Radha Yadav had a ball, taking 4 wickets. They were accurate with their lines and lengths but the fielding was a bit below par. The track is slow but the Indian batting is experienced enough to chase this down. Question is - if the top 3 get dismissed cheaply, then what happens? Stay tuned for the run chase.

As normal, Atapattu went hard at the top, scoring 33 out of the team's 48 in the 9th over. The Lankans then lost their way. Spinners were hard to get by but Kavisha Dilhari's cameo took the total past 100. Her unbeaten 25 from 16 balls ensured that there is something for the bowlers to bowl at.

On paper, this is a below-par total. But given the way the morning game unfolded and also that Atapattu felt at the toss that 120 was enough, we could be in for a good game. Not the best of batting efforts by Sri Lanka but they huffed and puffed their way to ensure that they at least bat out their 20 overs.
FOUR! A fine way to end the innings. Full on middle, Dilhari lofts it through the line and clears mid on! SRI LANKA FINISH ON 113/9!

DROPPED! A very, very difficult chance and a great attempt. A short ball, around off, Prabodhani backs away and pulls. But she does not quite get the elevation. Veda Krishnamurthy runs to her right from mid on, dives full stretch but cannot hang on. A single taken.
Punches this off the back foot for a run.
Short and outside off, sliced over point for a couple.

DROPPED! That should have been taken. Landed outside off, Prabodhani backs away and looks to guide this to third man. There is extra bounce on this one and hence, the outside edge is taken. It goes straight to the keeper but Taniya Bhatia fluffs a simple chance. A single taken to third man.
Udeshika Prabodhani is the last batter.
OUT! BOWLED! That is a terrific delivery. A length ball, around middle, Sandeepani looks to defend but the ball seams away, goes past the outside edge and knocks the off stump out of the ground!
Shikha Pandey to bowl the final over. 3-0-26-0 so far.
Sathya Sandeepani is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is a terrific catch by the skipper. A length ball, outside off, de Silva comes down the track and looks to swing hard. Gets a top edge. The ball seems to be clear mi-wicket but Harmanpreet Kaur runs back from he circle, keeps her eyes on it and takes a ripper!
Full and outside off, de Silva looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.
Full and outside off, Dilhari looks to slog but gets a thick inside edge which goes past the leg stump. A single taken.
Outside off, chipped over mid off for a brace.
Outside off, swept through square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Poonam Yadav eventually comes back on. 3-0-15-0 so far.

Excellent stop. Full and outside off, Dilhari comes down the track and drives it through the covers. It is in the gap but Harmanpreet Kaur at wide mid off throws her body on the line and stops the ball to her left. Just a single.
Comes down the track and works it through mid on for one more.
Full and down the leg side, paddled to short fine leg for a single.

DIRECT HIT WOULD HAVE HAD DE SILVA! Or, a throw to the keeper would have had Dilhari. Full and around middle, Dilhari comes down the track and works it towards wide long on. She takes the single and is happy. But her partner wants the second. Dilhari starts to run after the throw comes in and would have been gone had the throw been to the keeper. Still, if the throw had found its mark at the bowler's end, de Silva would have been found short.
Comes down the track again and this time works it towards long on for a single.
Full and outside off, de Silva comes down the track and drives, but back to the bowler.
Deepti Sharma to bowl out. 3-0-10-1 so far.
A full toss, outside off, slapped through the covers for a couple. Good fielding by Jemimah Rodrigues in the deep.
Outside off, played through point for a run.

Unlucky for the keeper. Full and oustide off, Dilhari gets across to paddle but the ball hits the toe end of the bat. Now, the keeper is moving down the leg side but the ball goes to her right and she cannot stop it, in spite of sticking out her right leg. A single taken to short third man.
Outside off, played straight to point.
FOUR! Cheeky. Full and outside leg, Dilhari gets down and across and paddles it to the right of short fine leg!
Outside off, de Silva looks to cut but gets a bottom edge onto the keeper's pads. She fumbles and concedes a single.
Shikha Pandey returns. 2-0-17-0 so far.
Slowly bowled on middle, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, pushed towards short third man for a run.
Full and outside off, chipped over cover for a single.
Short and outside off, sliced behind point for a couple.
Kavisha Dilhari walks in at number 9, replacing Sanjeewani.

OUT! LBW! The review is retained but not the batter. Full and around leg, Sanjeewani gets down, reaches out, looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. India appeal and the umpire agrees, after some thought. Sanjeewani and de Silva get into a long discussion and after an age, signal for the review. Ball Tracker shows it to be clipping the top of the bails, so the review is retained but since it is umpire's call, Sanjeewani has to go.

A delayed call to go for the LBW review. De Silva has been adjudged OUT and it does look out. Did it pitch outside leg? Nope. Ball Tracker shows the pitching to be perfect but the ball to be clipping the top of the bails. Umpire's call.
Short and outside off, chopped straight to cover.
Full and outside off, swept towards deep backward square leg for a single. 4 runs and a wicket from the over, Gayakwad finishes with figures of 4-1-18-2!
Full and outside off, de Silva just pushes it to the left of the bowler and takes a quick single.
Anushka Sanjeewani walks in at number 8, replacing Siriwardene.

OUT! Catching practice. Unbelievable batting. Full and around middle, Siriwardene backs away and swings hard, aiming to clear long on. But there is barely any power and she finds Veda Krishnamurthy running to her right at the fence. No point in playing that shot, especially when the side is half down.
Around middle, de Silva gets across and works it through square leg for a single.
Short and outside off, slapped through the covers for a single.
Landed outside off, Siriwardene looks to run it down to third man but misses.
Goes back in her crease to defend.

Almost a return catch! Full and around leg, Siriwardene looks to defend but the ball sticks on the surface, comes on slowly, hits the bat and then lobs. Radha tries to get across to her right for the catch but the ball goes through to long on. A single taken.
Nilakshi de Silva walks in now, at number 7, replacing Karunaratne.

OUT! CAUGHT, BUT NEARLY A SIX! A schoolkid error from Veda. Full and around middle, Karunaratne comes down the track and looks to go over the top but does not quite get the elevation. Veda Krishnamurthy at long on gets a simple catch, takes it but almost makes a meal of the same, running behind, losing momentum. Nearly touches the ropes but  manages to hang on.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, delicately played towards third man for a run.
Short and outside off, slapped through the covers for a single.
Radha Yadav returns. 2-0-16-2 so far.
FOUR! Up and over! Full and outside off, Siriwardene reaches out and lofts it over mid off. The fielder is in the ring.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.

DROPPED! Should have been taken. Full and outside off, Karunaratne comes down the track, looks to go over the top but mistimes it. The ball goes straight to the bowler who gets a simple catch to her left but puts it down, deflecting the ball towards cover. A single taken.
Slightly quicker from Gayakwad, Karunaratne looks to cut but misses.
Long hop again, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad is back on. 2-1-7-1 so far.
Short and outside off, slapped to deep cover for a run.
Another ultra-slow delivery, Karunaratne has to wait, then try to flick is done by lack of pace too and gets a thick inside edge onto her pads.
Comes down the track yet again, is done in flight, but adjusts well to work this from middle stump towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Good use of the feet. Flighted on middle, Siriwardene comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and chips it nicely over the bowler. Beats long on.
Short and outside off, slapped straight to short extra cover.
59 ks out of the hand, looped up on middle, watchfully defended.
That is really ell played. Karunaratne backs away, waits for the ball and guides this late, but finds short third man. 8 runs but a wicket as well from the over. Radha Yadav's figures read 2-0-16-2.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
WIDE. Down the leg side, sweep shot missed.
Tossed up outside off, watchfully defended towards mid off for a quick single.
Shashikala Siriwardene walks in now, at number 6, replacing Hasini.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Great catch by Taniya Bhatia. Full and outside off, going away with the angle, Perera looks to defend but gets a feather of an outside edge. This is snaffled by Bhatia. They appeal, the umpire takes his time but eventually raises his finger. Sri Lanka are disintegrating now.

FOUR! Landed outside off, guides through the vacant slip cordon towards third man. Short third man (Rajeshwari Gayakwad) tries to stop it, gets to the ball, but while trying to flick it back, her right foot touches the ropes.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a couple.
Shorter, around leg, worked towards deep square leg for one more. 52/3 at the halfway stage.
Another slower ball, 56 kph, Hasini comes down the track but is forced to defend.
Down the leg side, swept straight to short fine leg.
Comes down the track, takes the ball on the full and works it towards short mid-wicket. The non-strikers is looking for the single but is sent back.
Slow, slow, slow loopy ball, around middle, watchfully pushed towards cover.

JUST OVER! Full and around off, Karunaratne comes down the track and lofts it straight back. Poonam leaps, stretches out her right hand, but misses. Only if she had been a little taller. A single taken down to long on.
Poonam Yadav returns. 1-0-7-0 so far.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
WIDE. Down the leg side again, this time Karunaratne misses her sweep.
Full and outside leg, swept straight to short fine leg.
Hasini Perera walks in at number 5, replacing her skipper.

OUT! CAUGHT! Six and gone. Atapattu goes - is that the end of Sri Lanka as well? Short in length, Chamari rocks back and looks to pull. She hits this really hard but does not have enough elevation. Shikha Pandey is waiting for it patiently and takes it at deep square leg! Out of Sri Lanka's 48, the skipper has scored 33.
SIX! TONK! Dear me, the first one of the entire day! Full and outside off, Atapattu gets down and mows a slog sweep over mid-wicket! That was raw power.
Full and down the leg side, flicked straight to short fine leg.
Radha Yadav to bowl now.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended. WICKET MAIDEN!
Full and outside off, eased straight to cover again.
Full and outside off, this is eased straight to cover.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Hansima Karunaratne walks in at number 4, replacing Madavi.

OUT! BOWLED! That has gone between the legs! Change of ends works straightaway for Rajeshwari. A loopy ball, around middle, Madavi gets across, looking to flick. But the ball goes straight, misses the bat, hits the front pad and then deflects onto the middle stump!
Rajeshwari Gaywakwad returns. 1-0-7-0 so far.
FOUR! She had to wait an age for that. Short and loopy outside off, spinning in, just 59 kph, Atapattu waits, waits, waits, goes back and punches it through the covers.
Goes for the sweep initially but then seeing the length too full, flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Full and down the leg side, swept through square leg for one more.
Around middle and leg, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
A low full toss, outside leg, swept through fine leg for a single.
Poonam Yadav to bowl now.
Outside off, punched straight to cover. 35/1 in the Powerplay. Neither side will be too unhappy.
Full and down the leg side, Madavi misses her flick and the ball goes off her pads towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and down the leg side, swept through fine leg for a couple.
Short and outside off, Madavi rocks back and looks to cut but misses.
Deepti Sharma to bowl from a different end in the final over of the Powerplay.
Outside off, a play and a miss.

Full and outside off, Atapattu pushes at it. The ball goes off the outside edge, through the vacant slip cordon, towards third man. Poonam Yadav gives it a good chase from short third man and keeps the ball in play. Two runs taken.
EDGED, DROPPED! That should have been taken. Outside off, Atapattu looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. It goes to the keeper but Taniya is not able to catch it.
FOUR! Full and down the leg side, Atapattu gets down and sweeps it over square leg for a boundary!
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad into the attack now.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Full and outside off, Atapattu swings through the line and clears mid off with ease.
Full and around off, Harshitha looks to push it to third man but gets a thick outside edge, through the vacant slip region. A single taken.
Landed outside off, dabbed towards third man for a run.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
FOUR! Nicely played. On a length outside off, Madavi backs away and steers it through third man. Shafali Verma puts in a valiant dive to her left at short third man but misses.
Around off, solidly defended.
Full and around middle, slogged towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, cut towards point. There is a bit of a fumble from Rajeshwari Gayakwad but no run taken.
Around off, well defended.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Harshitha Madavi comes in at number 3, replacing Thimashini.

OUT! CAUGHT! There goes the first wicket. Full and outside off, tossed up just a bit wide, Thimashini gives herself room to the leg side and looks to go inside out but skies it high in the air. Simple catch for Rajeshwari Gayakwad at point.
FOUR! Fine shot. Full on middle, Atapattu gives herself room to the leg side and smashes it over the bowler for a boundary!
Full and outside off, Thimashini looks to push but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man. A single taken.
Outside off, Thimashini looks to steer it to third man but misses.
Full on middle, tucked wide of mid on for a single.
Landed outside off, angling away, left alone.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Pace from the other end. Shikha Pandey to bowl.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed outside off, Chamari pushes and misses.
FOUR! Gets it away this time. Down the leg side, this is swept to the fine leg fence.
Full and outside leg, Atapattu looks to defend but misses and is hit on the pads.
Full and outside off, swept through fine leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Thimashini looks to defend but the ball spins in and beats the outside edge.

We are done with the national anthems. The players are out in the middle. Chamari Atapattu and Umesha Thimashini are the openers for Sri Lanka. India start with spin. Deepti Sharma it will be, to Thimashini. Here we go...
Time for the national anthems. Sri Lanka's first.

India (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Taniya Bhatia (WK), Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Deepti Sharma, Veda Krishnamurthy, Shikha Pandey, Radha Yadav, Poonam Yadav and Rajeshwari Gayakwad.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Chamari Atapattu (C), Umesha Thimashini, Hasini Perera, Hansima Karunaratne, Shashikala Siriwardene, Harshitha Madavi, Anushka Sanjeewani (WK), Nilakshi de Silva, Kavisha Dilhari, Sathya Sandeepani and Udeshika Prabodhani.

Indian captain, Harmanpreet Kaur says that India are okay with both batting or fielding but feels this is a great opportunity to accept the challenge of chasing. Informs that they are unchanged from the previous game. Believes that India have been doing quite well and hence, does not want to try any new things.

Sri Lankan skipper, Chamari Atapattu, says that she is very confident about her batting unit, hence the reason. On the focus, given that Sri Lanka have been knocked out, Chamari says that  playing positive cricket is the only focus. Informs that they have made one change, with Sathya Sandeepani coming in for Achini Kulasuriya. Feels that 120 could be a good score on this wicket.
TOSS - Time for the spin of the coin. Harmanpreet Kaur has the coin in her hands, she flips the coin and Heads is the call from Chamari Atapattu. It is a Head. SRI LANKA WILL BAT FIRST.

Hola there! Welcome back after the break. New Zealand beating Bangladesh has meant that both, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka are already knocked out. This is a dead rubber but both sides have something to play for. India would aim to finish on top with a win, while Sri Lanka would look to get some points on the board.
